description: A task to help preschool students understand size comparisons.

engage.speech_start: Hello! Today we are looking at things that are very big, and very small!
engage.speech_end: Let's learn how to tell them apart.
engage.description: Playing an animation showing an elephant and a mouse.

explore.speech_start: Can you stretch your arms out really wide to show something BIG?
explore.activity_description: Stretch arms wide for big, and bring hands close together for small.

explain.speech_start: Big means it takes up a lot of space. Small means it takes up a tiny bit of space.
explain.speech_end: Now you know what big and small means.
explain.description: Robot visually shows a big house and a small house.

elaborate.speech_start: Let's see if we can find the big object.

evaluate.speech_start: Okay, your turn to find the small object all by yourself.
